detect.signature: src/canalRecall/repeatedBuildings/signature.ts: BAG ring in RD New, collinear-simplified (0.15 m), centroid + MRR long axis frame; symmetric Hausdorff over 4 poses (8 when square-ish), mirrored copies match
detect.exposure: ride-visibility.ts sampleRoutes(800 routes, seed 7), Σ 5 m × passes of samples within 35 m of the footprint
detect.sources: bag-tiles/14 (BAG CC0 + 3DBAG CC BY 4.0), building-facts (RCE register), streets-routing (OSM ODbL), panoramas data.amsterdam.nl (CC BY 4.0)

method.rule: footprint group = candidate; membership decided on the front photo (opus montage review)
